candidates.description: This vector activates on prefixes of Spanish words and Spanish-related terms.
This vector represents anatomical terms and biological structures, particularly related to body parts, organs, and physiological systems.
This feature activates on tokens containing roots related to preservation, conservation, service, or resolution (-serv-, -solv-).
This vector represents Portuguese auxiliary, copular, and modal verbs indicating existence, state, or tense.
This vector represents suffixes and words associated with Portuguese and Spanish adverbs and nominal derivations.
This vector represents characters with acute accent marks, primarily vowels, commonly found in accented Romance or Slavic languages.
This vector activates on common Portuguese morphological suffixes, grammatical prepositions, and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents common Spanish root words, prefixes, and morphological stems.
This vector represents Portuguese word endings featuring the letter sequence "-as".
These tokens represent Portuguese determiners, pronouns, and numbers related to quantity, possession, and definiteness.
